conflicts.resolution: Report launch-year column is not ingested as first-ever launch. Gateway II table says 2023 while prior dated releases describe 2022 launch; all Gateway rows remain unassigned.
Launched counts are retained as table populations, not canonical total inventory. Generic Granada and Bay/Gateway identities remain unresolved.

excludedCandidates.reason: Brochure and developer timeline distinguish phases but catalogue lacks a discriminating identity; Gateway II financials and original Gateway delivery are not attached to the project.
South-labelled brochure filename has generic Bay content; no verified South-to-Phase-II mapping. Both Bay financial rows remain unassigned.
Generic name remains ambiguous between original villas and 80-home Granada Extension. No 2010 delivery or extension financials assigned to this project.

methodology: Visual row/column review of pages 10 and 26. Cumulative developer sales and backlog are separate from registered transactions and property prices. No per-unit divisions, phase fan-out, inferred publication date, future-model availability or NIL-to-zero conversion.
